I checked the five oldest ongoing lines against this week's mail and they are still valid. No question was due, and the inbox held no sleep-task or feedback blocks. I refreshed `state.md` and the domain indexes, and moved the processed logs to `memory/archive/inbox/`. As the run preamble says, I did not push; the runner's own `dataset/runs/sleep-068.transcript.jsonl` is left untracked.
